title: A generator acts null-homotopically on the Koszul complex
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, r a natural number, f : Fin r → A, and i : Fin r. On the chain complex K of [def-weil-pbc-koszul-complex], multiplication by f(i) is chain homotopic to zero. The homotopy is given in degree q by exterior multiplication by the standard basis vector e_i.

source.place: Tags 0626 and 0663, Lemmas 15.29.5 and 15.29.6; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0626 and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0663

proof.text: Define degree-q h by left exterior multiplication with ι(e_i), where e_i = Finsupp.single i 1. The image is in exterior degree q+1 by the submodule power multiplication rule. This is the real linear map generatorWedge in the Lean module.

Mathlib CliffordAlgebra.contractLeft_ι_mul gives D(ι(e_i)x) = f_i • x - ι(e_i)D(x), so d h + h d = f_i times the identity in every positive degree. In degree zero, Submodule.mem_one writes x as an algebraMap scalar, which contraction kills by contractLeft_algebraMap. These are generatorWedge_identity and generatorWedge_zero_identity, both proved.

Set the Homotopy component from q to m to generatorWedge followed by equality transport if q+1=m, and zero otherwise. Use the two identities to prove its comm field in degree zero and successor degrees. The off-diagonal zero field follows immediately. The construction covers the zero ring and has no i when r=0.

lean.statement:
theorem koszul_generator_homotopy
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → A) (i : Fin r) :
    Nonempty (Homotopy ((f i) • 𝟙 (koszulComplex A r f)) 0)
